outcome: Early-onset group B Streptococcus (EOGBS) infection rates
cohort: All women who gave birth at a secondary healthcare organization in North West London between April 2016 and March 2017 (postscreening period) compared to those who gave birth between 2009-2013 (prescreening) and 2014-2015 (screening)
finding: Reversion from screening-based to risk-based intrapartum antimicrobial prophylaxis (IAP) for prevention of early-onset group B Streptococcus (EOGBS) infection resulted in a fivefold increase in EOGBS rates compared to the screening period, returning to prescreening levels.
mod_finding: This study focuses on the impact of different Group B Strep screening protocols and does not directly compare outcomes by mode of delivery.
